host.title: Hostname
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the IBM i system running the Mapepire server.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port of the Mapepire server. Defaults to 8076 when not supplied.

database.title: Database name
database.description: Name of the Db2 for i database to read data from.

username.title: Username
username.description: Use a read-only account. This platform reads data and never writes to the database. For added protection, use a dedicated account with read only access.
